answer: Proof of useful work functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent networks. By requiring each vertex in the network topology to solve a computationally expensive task—analogous to smelting ferrous ore—the system imposes a tangible overhead on identity generation. This cost scales linearly with the network size, forcing attackers to burn massive energy resources. Like a river eroding a canyon, the cumulative difficulty ensures that creating thousands of fake identities remains economically prohibitive and technically infeasible.
